instructions: Documentation only. Duplicate this file under a new name, replace every placeholder with reviewed real-job evidence, and remove documentation_only before processing.
content_rule: Provide exactly one of exported_html_path or job_description_raw. Local HTML paths resolve relative to the manifest and never trigger network access.
company_name: REQUIRED: company name shown by the reviewed source
collection_authorization_note: REQUIRED: reviewer, review date, public/export basis, and permitted local use
job_description_raw: DOCUMENTATION ONLY: replace with a verbatim pre-extracted description, or remove this field and provide exported_html_path.
